headline: Week 7: you have no kicker, a thin RB room and McLaurin likely lost for the year, so use waivers on an RB and a kicker.
alerts: Waivers: claim an RB (Kendre Miller or Dameon Pierce) and a kicker (Chad Ryland or Jake Bates). Drop McLaurin, Mitchell or Hurts.
Terry McLaurin was carted off Monday with a feared season-ending knee injury. Washington is on bye anyway.
Byes: Chargers (Mitchell) and Commanders (McLaurin). Jalen Hurts is on IR and likely out for the season.
Josh Jacobs is off the exempt list. If he plays Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific, Lloyd becomes a weak RB2.
Hockenson (concussion) must clear protocol. Ferguson plays Monday 5:15 PM Pacific as a fallback.
Locks: Sun 10:00 AM Jefferson, Hockenson, Downs, B. Robinson, Jets D. 1:05 PM Brissett. 1:25 PM St. Brown, Golden, Lloyd. Mon 5:15 PM Ferguson.
Sleeper could not be reached this run, so the roster is from an earlier run. Confirm waiver targets are still free in your league.

ARI.note: Vs. Denver Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Broncos -4.5, total 43.5, Arizona about 19.5 implied. RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) may return.

GB.note: At Detroit Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Lions -3, total 52.5, Packers about 24.75 implied. Josh Jacobs is eligible to return.

DET.note: Vs. Green Bay Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Lions -3, total 52.5, about 27.75 implied. Back from bye.

ATL.note: Vs. San Francisco Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. 49ers -4.5, total 50.5, Falcons about 23 implied.

MIN.note: Vs. Indianapolis Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Vikings -6, total 41.5. Back from bye, Hockenson and Addison questionable, Jordan Mason designated to return.

IND.note: At Minnesota Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Colts about 18 implied. Sauce Gardner doubtful, Tyler Warren questionable.

NYJ.note: Vs. Miami Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Jets -4.5, total 38.5. Breece Hall status TBD.

DAL.note: At Philadelphia Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. Cowboys -5.5, total 44.5. Eagles without Hurts, Barkley still not cleared.

PHI.note: Vs. Dallas Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. Hurts on IR, Barkley (hamstring) TBD, Dameon Pierce handled every RB carry in Week 6.

WAS.note: Bye week. McLaurin feared to have a season-ending knee injury.

3257.name: Jacoby Brissett
notes: Week 6: 24 of 35 for 218 yards, 0 TD, 1 INT in an 18-16 win at the Rams. Six field-goal drives, no TDs.
Vs. Denver Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Broncos -4.5, total 43.5, Arizona about 19.5 implied.
Only healthy QB on the roster with Hurts out, so he starts by default. RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) may return.
